name: stunning-tang-phoenix-beauty-close-up
image_vibe: Dreamy refined Tang-dynasty-inspired beauty with rouge pink, gilded gold, and cool atmospheric haze
image_purpose: Create a high-concept historical fashion portrait for editorial or fantasy campaign use.

prompt.project_info: A 9:16 half-body portrait of an original adult East Asian woman styled in Tang-dynasty-inspired pink luxury costume and a phoenix crown.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult East Asian woman with natural translucent-looking skin texture and a subtle luminous glow, delicate three-dimensional facial features, narrow phoenix eyes, long eyelashes, a soft affectionate gaze, smudged rouge lip color, and a gentle emotionally nuanced expression. She wears a layered pink Tang-dynasty-inspired costume with a moderate neckline, an ornate phoenix crown made of metal, pearls, gemstones, and tassels, and softly guided hands.
prompt.composition_elements: Half-body close-up with visual focus on face and upper body, body slightly sideways or lightly rotated, neck extended, relaxed shoulders, hands creating soft guiding lines, shallow bokeh background, and cinematic spatial perspective.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm golden side-front key light on face and skin, cool environmental fill shaping volume, rim light outlining hair and neck-shoulder contours, controlled highlights, detailed shadows, dreamy refined oriental atmosphere with slight haze.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm portrait lens, f/1.4-f/2, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical framing, hyper-realistic CG-inspired portrait, realistic metal, pearl, gemstone, textile, hair, and skin texture, slight film grain, soft-focus glow, 8K-style clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 half-body portrait of an original adult East Asian woman in a refined Tang-dynasty-inspired fashion editorial. Give her natural realistic skin texture with a subtle luminous glow, delicate three-dimensional facial features, narrow phoenix eyes, long eyelashes, a soft affectionate gaze, smudged rouge lip color, and a gentle emotionally nuanced expression. Dress her in a layered pink luxury costume with a moderate neckline and an ornate phoenix crown made of metal, pearls, gemstones, and tassels. Pose the body slightly sideways or lightly rotated with the neck extended, shoulders relaxed, and hands forming soft guiding lines. Use a warm golden side-front key light, cool environmental fill, rim light outlining the hair and neck-shoulder contours, controlled highlights, detailed shadows, shallow bokeh background, an 85mm lens at f/1.4-f/2, slight film grain, soft-focus glow, realistic textile and jewelry materials, cinematic low-saturation rouge-pink, gilded-gold, and cool cyan-blue-gray palette, high-resolution 8K-style clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, public-figure likeness, exaggerated anatomy, extra fingers, malformed crown, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text
